 Gil Vicente v FC Porto: Pietuszewski injured in warm-up, Borja Sainz starts 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Oskar Pietuszewski suffered a warm-up injury before Gil Vicente v FC Porto in Barcelos, with Borja Sainz brought into the line-up.
 According to O Jogo, the FC Porto winger left the starting group and went to the medical team complaining of pain in his left thigh, looking worried.
 OneFootball Videos
 Sainz stepped in during the warm-up among the starters, then took Pietuszewski's place in the starting XI.
 Pietuszewski will watch the match from the stands.
 João Costa moves to the substitutes' bench.
 Source: O Jogo
